about: The AI clients privacyfence.eu names as tested, in one place (guardrail 10, tests/unit/test_website_clients.py). scripts/build_site.py renders the homepage's 'Works with' strip (an `include: clients` line) and the JSON-LD softwareRequirements from this file. Each client's `slug` names its page, /ai-agents/<slug>/, and its setup doc, /docs/connect-<slug>/ (guardrail 14, tests/unit/test_website_agent_pages.py). Add a client here when a release supports it and its docs page is in that release's /docs/, not before.

clients.name: claude.ai
clients.connects: straight to an organization deployment's /mcp over HTTPS, with OAuth sign-in
